participants: Janelle Reyes (Orion Retail - Head of Data)
messages:
Priya Shah (CSM): Hi @Janelle — welcome! I'm Priya, your CSM for the Redwood rollout. Wanted to align on stakeholders, success criteria, and a rough timeline for the next 6 weeks. Can you confirm who should be looped in from Orion?
Janelle Reyes (Orion Retail - Head of Data): Thanks Priya. I'll be the exec sponsor. Please include: Samir (ML eng), Tori (Platform), and Dana (Security).
Marcus Li (AE): Adding Samir and Tori to the thread — they should see the deployment options. Happy to intro on a call if helpful.
Liam O'Connor (Solutions Engineer): Quick Q on environment: will you be starting on Hosted API or Private (VPC)? That changes the required pre-reqs.
Janelle Reyes (Orion Retail - Head of Data): We want Hosted to start, but evaluate Private later. Priority 1: reduce inference latency for product recommendations. Priority 2: privacy for PII.
Priya Shah (CSM): Got it. Tentative success criteria from our side to validate in pilot: 1) 95th pct latency < 200ms for 1K qps test, 2) embeddings accuracy on your eval set >= current baseline, 3) secure logs + consent flow for PII. Agree?
Janelle Reyes (Orion Retail - Head of Data): Sounds right. For embeddings, we'll share a 500-sample eval set by EOD Fri.
Liam O'Connor (Solutions Engineer): Plan: week 1 — access + test dataset, week 2 — smoke tests on Hosted, week 3 — latency & cost tuning, week 4 — embed eval & enablement. Can we schedule a 60m kickoff tomorrow to run through access and roles?
Priya Shah (CSM): I can do tomorrow 10am PT. Marcus — can you send calendar invite and include onboarding runbook link? :calendar: @onboard-bot, please create an onboarding checklist item for Orion Retail.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Orion Retail — Redwood Launch Prep" 2025-09-03 17:00 UTC. Onboarding checklist created (ID: ORN-2025-09).
Marcus Li (AE): Invite sent. Also attaching the quickstart doc and the security questionnaire in the calendar event.
Janelle Reyes (Orion Retail - Head of Data): Thanks all — we'll have Samir and Tori on the call. One risk: current infra uses an older auth system; Tori will need SSO mapping details.
Priya Shah (CSM): Noted — action items: (a) Orion to share eval dataset + SSO contact (b) Redwood to provision test API key + run initial smoke tests (c) schedule enablement session for product and platform teams. I'll keep a living checklist in the doc.
Liam O'Connor (Solutions Engineer): I'll prep a short runbook for the smoke tests and a checklist for SSO mapping (will post in channel before the call).
Janelle Reyes (Orion Retail - Head of Data): Great, see you tomorrow.
Priya Shah (CSM): Thanks — talk then. :thumbsup:
